title: Interior Design Studio London | Curated Design
metaDescription: A London-based interior design studio shaping distinctive residential, hospitality, and commercial spaces, from concept through completion.

hero.headline: Interiors conceived, visualised and delivered.
hero.subhead: Curated Design is a London-based interior design studio creating distinctive residential and commercial spaces. From concept development and photorealistic visualisations to furniture sourcing, procurement and installation, we provide a considered approach to design from beginning to end.

process.heading: A considered process, from concept to completion.

steps.label: Brief & Discovery
steps.title: Understanding your space.
steps.text: We establish your requirements, aesthetic preferences, budget and timescale, with site visits and measurements where required.

steps.label: Concept & Visualisation
steps.title: Explore the possibilities.
steps.text: We develop layouts, material palettes and photorealistic visualisations, exploring alternative design directions where appropriate before final decisions are made.

steps.label: Specification & Pricing
steps.title: A design grounded in reality.
steps.text: Furniture, lighting, finishes and accessories are carefully specified using real, sourceable products, accompanied by clear product information and itemised pricing.

steps.label: Procurement & Installation
steps.title: Bringing the vision to life.
steps.text: We coordinate purchasing, deliveries and installation with the relevant suppliers and contractors, overseeing the final details that complete the space.

process.intro: Every project follows a structured approach, bringing together creative design, detailed specifications and practical coordination.
process.offer: Layouts, a material palette, and photo-realistic visuals show exactly how each room will look and feel, starting with a free photo-realistic render of your space.

collectionsSection.heading: Featured project.
collectionsSection.lead: A completed residential lobby refresh in Marylebone, shaped through architectural detailing, sculptural furniture, and layered lighting.

specification.heading: Visualised. Specified. Realised.
specification.description: Our designs are developed around real spaces, considered budgets and carefully sourced products. By combining detailed visualisations with furniture specifications, we help clients understand not only how their interiors could look, but how they can be brought to life.

views.label: Before · Empty room
views.alt: Empty living room with classical wall panelling, arched windows and sunlit oak flooring.

views.label: After · Furnished concept
views.alt: The same room furnished with a sectional sofa, lounge chairs, a stone coffee table and a sculptural chandelier.
